_note: DEMO data. The biology (subgroups, mechanisms, treatments) reflects real Parkinson's research directions, but source_id values are placeholders (DEMO-*). Run literature_agent.py to backfill real PMIDs / NCT ids, or hand-verify before the demo. Do not present DEMO ids to judges as real.

subgroups.name: GBA-mutation PD
subgroups.defining_features: GBA1 variant carriers; reduced glucocerebrosidase (GCase) activity; earlier onset, faster cognitive decline
subgroups.notes: Most common genetic risk factor for PD.

subgroups.name: LRRK2 PD
subgroups.defining_features: LRRK2 variant carriers (e.g. G2019S); elevated LRRK2 kinase activity; often milder, more benign motor course

subgroups.name: Alpha-synuclein-high PD
subgroups.defining_features: High alpha-synuclein aggregation / seeding activity on seed amplification assays
subgroups.notes: Targetable by anti-aggregation and immunotherapy approaches.

subgroups.name: Inflammation-high PD
subgroups.defining_features: Elevated neuroinflammatory markers; activated microglia signature

subgroups.name: Rapid motor progressors
subgroups.defining_features: Fast UPDRS-III progression; poorer levodopa-adjusted trajectory

evidence.title: GCase activity and lysosomal dysfunction in GBA-associated Parkinson's
evidence.key_result: Reduced GCase activity correlates with faster progression in GBA carriers; pharmacological GCase enhancement rescues lysosomal function in preclinical models.

evidence.title: Ambroxol as a GCase chaperone in GBA-PD
evidence.key_result: Phase 2 evaluating a GCase chaperone in GBA-mutation Parkinson's; target engagement reported in CSF.

evidence.title: LRRK2 kinase hyperactivity as a therapeutic target
evidence.key_result: LRRK2 inhibition reduces kinase activity and normalizes lysosomal markers in preclinical PD models.

evidence.title: Small-molecule LRRK2 inhibitor in LRRK2-PD
evidence.key_result: Phase 2 of an oral LRRK2 inhibitor in LRRK2-associated PD; safety and biomarker readouts ongoing.

evidence.title: Alpha-synuclein aggregation and clearance strategies
evidence.key_result: Promoting alpha-synuclein clearance reduces aggregate burden in models with high seeding activity.

evidence.title: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy
evidence.key_result: Phase 2 immunotherapy targeting aggregated alpha-synuclein; enrichment for high-seeding subgroup under study.

evidence.title: Microglial activation drives neurodegeneration in a PD subset
evidence.key_result: Microglial modulation reduces inflammatory markers and slows neuronal loss in inflammation-high models.

evidence.title: Predictors of rapid motor progression in PD
evidence.key_result: Rapid progressors show distinct trajectories; combination neuroprotective strategies proposed but unproven.
